verdict.rationale: An agent skill that bundles Python tools could plausibly collect usage data, so a telemetry opt-out is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out control. Dependency-free local tools and a local gallery are adjacent traits, not a documented opt-out.
